record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Can the elliptic estimates for maximal and constant-mean-curvature hypersurfaces be generalized to prove existence of a constant-mean-curvature hypersurface asymptotic to a prescribed cut of future null infinity in an asymptotically flat spacetime, and what are the weakest asymptotic assumptions on future null infinity for this result?

evidence.quote: Generalise the estimates of [BRl] to show the existence of a CMC hypersurface asymptotic to a given cut of ~+ in an AF spacetime. What are the weakest asymptotic conditions on ~ + for which this holds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be an asymptotically flat spacetime admitting a conformal completion with future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$. A spacelike hypersurface $\Sigma \subset M$ is said to have constant mean curvature (CMC) if its mean curvature with respect to the future-directed unit timelike normal is a (nonzero) constant. Given a smooth cut $C \subset \mathscr{I}^+$ (i.e., a cross-section of future null infinity diffeomorphic to a 2-sphere), one says that a spacelike hypersurface $\Sigma$ is asymptotic to $C$ if, in the conformal completion, the closure of $\Sigma$ meets $\mathscr{I}^+$ precisely along $C$.

(a) Generalize the elliptic a priori estimates available for maximal and constant-mean-curvature spacelike hypersurfaces so as to prove the following existence statement: for every sufficiently regular cut $C$ of $\mathscr{I}^+$ in an asymptotically flat spacetime $(M,g)$, there exists a constant-mean-curvature spacelike hypersurface $\Sigma \subset M$ asymptotic to $C$.

(b) Determine the weakest asymptotic decay/regularity assumptions on $\mathscr{I}^+$ (and on the spacetime near $\mathscr{I}^+$) under which this existence result holds.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results exist. Andersson and Iriondo (1999, gr-qc/9712036) proved existence of CMC hypersurfaces intersecting null infinity in a regular cut for a class of asymptotically Schwarzschild spacetimes satisfying an interior condition, via a barrier construction. The general question of the weakest asymptotic conditions on future null infinity for which such existence holds for an arbitrary prescribed cut in a general asymptotically flat spacetime does not appear to be fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Existence of Constant Mean Curvature Hypersurfaces in Asymptotically Flat Spacetimes
status_evidence.snippet: For a class of asymptotically Schwarzschild spacetimes satisfying an interior condition, existence of complete hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature which intersect null infinity in a regular cut is proven using a barrier construction.
status_evidence.claim: Existence is known under restrictive asymptotically Schwarzschild assumptions, indicating partial progress.

status_evidence.title: Existence of CMC Cauchy surfaces and spacetime splitting
status_evidence.snippet: Results on existence of CMC Cauchy hypersurfaces in spacetimes under various assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Related but distinct progress on CMC hypersurface existence in spacetimes.
